The tree is propagated easily from

Uses
The longan is particularly popular in
China and southeast Asia, where it is
eaten fresh, dried, and canned.  The fruit
also stores well when frozen.  Because it
is similar to the lychee, the longan can be
used as a substitute in a variety of recipes.
In addition to providing delicious fruit,
the longan tree is an attractive addition
to the garden, furnishing significant shade
because of the length and density of its
foliage.
LONGAN
Family  Sapindaceae
Scientific name Nephelium 
longana
Common name longan
♥High in vitamin C
Nutrient composition
Longans are high in vitamin C.  Fresh lon-
gans are significantly higher in vitamin C
than the dried form.  (See the Appendix,
page 436, for the nutrient content of dried
longan.)
The longan is a small fruit similar to the lychee.  
The fruit, which develops in drooping clusters, 
is about 1 inch in diameter and has a 
smooth, yellow-brown skin.  Inside is
a single black seed surrounded by 
white, translucent flesh that has a 
sweet, slightly musky flavor.
